title: Blue in the Cup
style: Contemporary R&B with jazzy chord extensions, slow laid-back swing, brushed drums, warm electric piano, muted sub bass, and soft guitar harmonics. Verse stays intimate with sparse keys and breathy runs; pre-chorus opens with stacked background ooohs and a lifted bass walk; chorus blooms with silky doubles and slow-call ad-libs. Gentle ride-bell sparkles, tape hiss, and a sax pickup into the bridge. Smooth, close-mic, velvety mix., healing, contemporary, r&b, calming, jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I set your ring by the sink
Next to the chipped blue cup
Morning came in soft
And I still got up

Your shirt stayed on the chair
Like it forgot to leave
I folded that old hurt
Till it fit my sleeve

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to hold my breath
When your name hit my phone
Now I let it ring out
I let it go

The room feels less like a wound
More like space to breathe
Something in me loosened
When I chose me

[Chorus]
I’m healing, healing
Slow and steady now
I’m healing, healing
Don’t you pull me down
Blue in the cup
But I’m still around
I’m healing, healing
Soft, but I’m not broke now

[Verse 2]
I put fresh sheets on the bed
Opened every shade
Let the noon light spill
Where the shadows stayed

Found my laugh in the sink
Found my voice in rain
Little by little
I’m not made of pain

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to wear your doubt
Like it fit my skin
Now I take a deep breath
And let it in

Not every scar is loud
Some just fade and glow
I can taste the future
When I move slow

[Chorus]
I’m healing, healing
Slow and steady now
I’m healing, healing
Don’t you pull me down
Blue in the cup
But I’m still around
I’m healing, healing
Soft, but I’m not broke now

[Bridge]
If I fall, I rise back
Gentle as dawn
No more begging old hurt
To keep me on

I left the hard parts there
Where they belong
Now my heart keeps time
With a smaller song

[Final Chorus]
I’m healing, healing
Slow and steady now
I’m healing, healing
Don’t you pull me down
Blue in the cup
But I’m still around
I’m healing, healing
Soft, and I’m whole now
